biggest_catch: $250 statement credit minus $0 annual fee = $250 net; only pursue it with spending already planned.
catches: Only pursue this bonus with spending you were already going to make — manufactured or extra spending can erase the gain.

Amex once-per-lifetime rule: the welcome offer is generally not available if you have or have had this exact card before; Amex also considers your history as an Amex Card Member and the number of cards opened/closed.
Applying for this card triggers a hard credit inquiry — do not apply unless you are ready for it.
This card's purchase APR is roughly 20%+; carrying a balance can wipe out the entire bonus — pay the statement balance in full every month.
No annual fee, so the full $250 is net gain if you meet the $3,000 threshold with planned spending.
You must be a legitimate business to apply — a sole proprietor applying with an SSN qualifies; the account will only be used for business purposes per the issuer's terms.

steps: Open the official Amex Blue Business Cash terms page and confirm the $250 offer, $3,000 threshold, and 3-month window.
Confirm you have not had this card or previous versions (Amex once-per-lifetime) and that you have a legitimate business (sole proprietor with SSN is fine).
Apply through the official Amex application; your 3-month window starts at account opening.
Charge $3,000 in planned business purchases in the first 3 months (eligible purchases exclude fees, gift cards, prepaid reloads, P2P payments).
Pay the statement balance in full every month so interest never eats the $250.
Watch your monthly billing statement — the $250 credit posts within 8-12 weeks after you reach $3,000 in eligible purchases.
